set.body:
Work key: L01.3
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Immediate target: docs/local-demo-plan.md
Accountable role: Product/backend/frontend engineer with local operator
Program scope: required

Scope: Reuse the organization fixture and real authentication/authority paths for a deterministic local demo.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Provision the versioned synthetic seed for two labs/projects, shared and restricted datasets, exact historical releases and steward/contributor/reader/guest accounts with retained content and identity mappings.
2. Configure a loopback local test provider through F04’s real browser-session adapter; no forged principal/header bypass or manual privileged database edits are part of ordinary user flows.
3. Repeated seed application is idempotent or explicitly conflicts; demonstrate each role’s permitted/denied visibility and that institutional configuration rejects the demo issuer/accounts.

Verification: Seed manifest, real browser/API/PostgreSQL account assertions, replay tests and demo-configuration rejection evidence.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/L01.3/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

References:
- docs/local-demo-plan.md
- docs/service-distribution.md
- docs/decisions/001-institutional-organization.md

Blocked by:
- L01.2: bd-01M4X5MA4YZE9RV4YSPEAXXZCB
- F06.1: bd-01M4W5P73PDDY9HX9J9F27RVRQ

Completion rule: satisfy every criterion with observed, source-bound evidence. Local fixtures and engineering checks cannot replace institutional approval, real-provider qualification, human accessibility or operator acceptance. No external outreach is authorized by this task.
set.title: L01.3: Seed the local two-lab demo and verified test-provider accounts
